## Change

What problem does this solve? Link the issue, if available.

## Verification

List the platform, revision or toolchain and focused checks you ran. For a visual change, include the Arabic input, font/version, expected result and a shareable before/after example. Identify anything that still needs a device or account.

## Rights

For new fonts, artwork, fixtures or dependencies, identify the upstream source, version, license and any required notices. By submitting your own changes to the covered code, you offer them under the repository license.
